notes.title: OFFICIAL CONTEST: Oriental Theme
notes.content:
[b]Designers Wanted![/b]

We have noticed our community share many screenshots. However most of them are from Survival Mode. Now it’s time to unleash the power of Creative Mode, that allows limitless designing and creativity.


[h1]YOUR TASK:[/h1]
[olist]
 [*]Create something amazing and breathtaking that will demonstrate the power of Creative Mode. Order of the day is "Oriental theme".
 [*]It can be anything that contains oriental blocks or related motif, for example - Japanese pagoda, Chinese dragon, cherry blossom garden... etc.
 [*] Remember, the best creations will be part of the game forever as the loading screens or video trailers!                                              
[/olist]

[h1]THE PRICE:[/h1]
[olist]
We will choose [b]the best 3 designers[/b]. Every designer gets the following:
 [*] [b]$100 USD[/b] (on Steam via Digital Gift Card or Paypal)
 [*] ethernal fame, your name or your nick will be added to game credits forever
 [*] your screenshot will be included to the game as a new loading screen or used in the official trailer!
[/olist]

[h1]HOW TO ENTER:[/h1]
[olist]
 [*] Take a screenshot in Cube Life Island Survival (Creative Mode) , upload it, and post the link to this forum thread.
([url=https://support.spryfox.com/hc/en-us/articles/218503698-How-do-I-share-a-Steam-screenshot-]Follow this guide how to upload a screenshot to Steam[/url])
 [*] Or tweet your screenshot using the hashtag #CubeLifeContest. Make sure you’re following us ([url=https://twitter.com/cubelife_island]@cubelife_island[/url]) so we can DM the winner.
[/olist]

[h1]GENERAL RULES:[/h1]
[olist]
 [*]The deadline for entries is 11:59 PM CET, May 26, 2018
 [*] Every user is allowed to submit only one entry and in only one category.
 [*] You have to build everything by yourself. We will ask winners to export the map ([b]clis file format[/b]), so we can check it provide to all users
 [*] Screenshots must be exactly 1920x1080 resolution the PNG or JPG format.
 [*] No GUI - go to Settings/Graphics/GUI on/off and get a clear shot.
 [*] No copyrighted stuff, no logos, no added post-processing or Photoshop, we want 100% game screenshots.
 [*] Make sure you are following us (Cypronia) via Steam, Twitter of Facebook, so we can contact you if you win.
 [*] Winners must export the map and send the [b]*.clis[/b] file to us
 [*] Winners agree to provide an unlimited, royalty-free license to Cypronia for the screenshot and the map file. 
 [*] Winners agree that their creations will be shared to public or used in the game or video for game presentation, etc.
[/olist]
Good luck!

notes.title: Cube Life: Island Survival Patch v1.6 is available for Download!

NEW FEATURES:
------------------------
*Recipe database in Inventory (click on any item and it shows all associated recipes)
* New Level system. Higher Level improves player's endurance, item's durability, furnace's effectivity, lower prices and more goods in trading



ADJUSTEMENTS:
-------------------------
* New icons design
* Added HotBar Slots for items (keys 1-0)
* Improved "stack item" feature
* Better visibility to see underwater (better to find the fish)

*********************

FIXES:
---------
*Fixed issue with tools durability (pickaxe, axe and sword)
*Ladder can be made from any tree, not banana stem only
*Fixed issue with crafting Bed (it doesn't need so many skins)
*Fixed other minor bugs
*Fixed Item's name covered by "Back button"



Special thanks goes to:

Jimbo, nasedo73, Utah1982, gamerfss86 and all who posted positive reviews! Thank you for supporting us!
